semantics: frozen v2 OR-pair definitional macro followed by exact Davis-Putnam elimination of a root pivot x

definitions.A: positive x-parent clauses containing both +x and b
definitions.Res(S,T): set of unique non-tautological x-resolvents between parent families S and T
definitions.Comp(A): clauses obtained from each (x OR b OR R) in A by frozen v2 replacement (-e OR R)
definitions.BridgeC: clauses (-e OR (C\{x})) created by resolving each C-parent with definition parent (-e OR -x)
definitions.BridgeN: non-tautological clauses (e OR b OR (N\{-x})) created by resolving definition parent (e OR x OR b) with each N-parent
definitions.Y: Comp(A) union BridgeC union BridgeN union {(-e,-b)}
definitions.mu(S): sum over clauses D in finite clause set S of (1+|D|)

proof: Before the macro, every x-resolvent is generated either by A x N or C x N, while R0 is retained; hence raw_pre = R0 union Res(C,N) union Res(A,N) = B union X.
The macro removes x from every A clause and retains the replacements Comp(A).
Its x-positive parents are C plus (e,x,b); its x-negative parents are N plus (-e,-x).

Resolving C x N reproduces Res(C,N). Resolving C with (-e,-x) produces BridgeC. Resolving (e,x,b) with N produces BridgeN when non-tautological. Resolving the two definition x-parents together is tautological because it contains both e and -e.
The definition clause (-e,-b) is retained. Therefore raw_post = B union Y.
For any finite weighted sets B,X,Y with additive clause weight 1+|D|, mu(B union X)-mu(B union Y)=mu(X\B)-mu(Y\B). The leading state-unit constant +1 cancels, proving the relief identity.

sufficient_rescue_corollary.statement: If the v2 macro itself fits the frozen state cap and mu(X\B)-mu(Y\B) >= U_raw(F,x)-N^2, then exact elimination of x after that macro fits N^2. For a live root x, the frozen progress potential also strictly decreases after the atomic macro+root-elimination step.

new_universal_gate.statement: Every reachable root-phase all-ordinary-pivot-overflow state admits some pivot-involving repeated pair (sign(x),b) for which the frozen macro fits and the exclusive rectangle mass exceeds star overhead by at least that pivot's overflow excess.
new_universal_gate.importance: If true, L1 root-phase grammar totality follows using only pivot-involving v2 pairs. If false, an exact reachable counterexample should be frozen.
